mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose from liver storage back into the blood was the most worthwhile passage. It connected glycogen storage to a practical supply for other tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the portal vessel was straightforward but offered little explanation in its result.

surprise.text: Nothing was particularly surprising; the offered combinations and item names made the sequence predictable.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though adding blood transport was a separate, predictable step after the liver had already been described as releasing glucose.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it revealed a new relationship between systems, but the predictable sequence alone would not strongly draw me onward.
